applicabilityBasis.summary: COTI presents DJED as a dollar-pegged stablecoin with payment ambitions. DJED product terms describe each token as redeemable for USD 1 worth of assets in the protocol pool at market prices. They identify Decentralized Solutions Limited, organized under BVI law, as the website and services provider, while expressly denying that company control of the protocol or custody of user assets. ADA redemption through smart contracts does not establish an identified legal issuer obligation to pay fixed monetary value under GENIUS section 2(22). General stablecoin and payment use leaves applicability unclear under the sweep rubric.

genius.notes: The independent verifier recovered https://djed.xyz/terms in isolated Chromium after a static 404. The product terms identify Decentralized Solutions Limited under BVI law as the interface and services provider, not as a legal issuer undertaking dollar redemption; issuerEntity and issuerDomicile remain omitted. The terms disclaim protocol operation, asset custody and smart-contract control. They exclude US persons and jurisdictions requiring specified regulatory approval, without expressly naming every EU/EEA country. These contractual restrictions do not establish a GENIUS statutory exemption or prevent direct smart-contract and secondary-token use. COTI (BVI) Limited in the general COTI website PDF is a different website operator and is not substituted for the token issuer. The FAQ was reopened in isolated Chromium and confirms ADA mint/burn mechanics and payment ambitions. Its displayed May 30, 2022 date precedes the launch described in its body. COTI's July 27, 2026 private-USDT/USDC article was reopened and contains no DJED GENIUS issuer-intent claim. Reserve/redemption explanations do not establish current monthly independent financial attestations; optional disclosure booleans remain unset. The Act remains pre-effective in the reviewed implementation record, with the general DASP sales restriction scheduled for July 18, 2028.

sourcesChecked: Independent 2026-10-07 official-domain search for Bucket Protocol, Enosys, DJED and COTI with GENIUS across OCC, Federal Reserve, FDIC, NCUA and Treasury; no exact matching approval, qualification, application or registration announcement located.
Independent 2026-10-07 reopening of DJED product terms naming Decentralized Solutions Limited only as interface/services provider, with no GENIUS authorization or dollar-paying issuer undertaking.
negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, the opened federal implementation materials, NYDFS directory, COTI articles, DJED product terms and targeted official-domain searches did not identify a qualifying public GENIUS approval, state qualification, pending application or foreign registration for DJED or its legal issuer. Product terms name Decentralized Solutions Limited as an interface provider and disclaim protocol control, so that company is not assigned as legal token issuer. This is a bounded negative-evidence finding, not proof that no confidential filing exists or that issuance is unlawful.
